activity.notes: Vlad III ruled Wallachia three times: 1448, 1456–1462, and 1476. ATLAS records the long central reign of 1456–1462 as his principal representative sovereign Activity; the two brief interrupted reigns are intentionally excluded from this registration.

sources.title: Counting the Stakes: Vlad III Dracula's Practice of Collective Impalements - Cambridge Core
sources.citation_text: Transactions of the Royal Historical Society identifies Vlad III as the three-time voivode of Wallachia, ruling in 1448, 1456–62, and 1476.
